ja: • ふなっしーのコミカルな動きや質感を追求。
• 頭・胴体には軟質素材を使用。凹ませて質感を楽しむこともできる。
• 腰は前後左右だけでなくひねりの動きも可能。ふなっしーらしいポーズをとれる。
• 腕は付け根がボールジョイント、肘は関節入り。いろいろなポーズで遊べる。
• 背中にある「イリュージョン」も立体感を出して再現。
• 目や口、ほっぺ、リボンなど細部までパーツやシールで再現。
• 梨をモチーフにした台座が付属。
成形品×6、シール×1、組立説明書(箱裏に印刷)
成形品×6、シール×1、組立説明書(箱裏に印刷)
en: • Pursuing Funassyi's comical movements and textures.
• Soft material is used for the head and body. You can also enjoy the texture by denting it.
• The waist can move not only forward, backward, left and right, but also twist. You can pose like Funassyi.
• The arms have ball joints at the base and joints at the elbows. You can play with various poses.
• The "illusion" on the back is also reproduced with a three-dimensional effect.
• Details such as eyes, mouth, cheeks, and ribbons are reproduced with parts and seals.
• Comes with a pedestal with a pear motif.
Molded product x 6, Seal x 1, Assembly manual (printed on the back of the box)
